verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यासन् पुत्रा वै नव तत्समाः। इक्ष्वाकुश्चैव नाभागो धृष्णुः शर्यातिरेव च॥१॥
नरिष्यंश्च तथा प्रांशुर्नाभागारिष्टसप्तमाः। करूषश्च पृषध्रश्च नवैते भरतर्षभ॥२॥
verses.english: "I resulted from the quiddities of mitra and varuNa, oh, ablest debater, hence it will be apt of me to follow them... let me not ruin my duty..." So said lady ila to vaivasvata manu.
verses.bhavadeepa: मनोर्वै श्राद्धदेवस्य सन्ततिर्दशधा तथा। सौम्यात्तदंशभेदश्च दशमोऽध्याय इष्यते॥१॥ मनोरिति। तत्समाः मनुतुल्याः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अकरोत्पुत्रकामस्तु मनुरिष्टिं प्रजापतिः। मित्रावरुणयोस्तात पूर्वमेव विशाम्पते॥३॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the tenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of लद्य् इल.
verses.bhavadeepa: नाभागारिष्ट इत्यत्र दिष्ट इत्यपि पठन्ति। “नाभानेदिष्ठं वै मानवम्” इति श्रुतेः। नाभानेदिष्ठ इति पाठः प्रामाणिकः॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: अनुत्पन्नेषु नवसु पुत्रेष्वेतेषु भारत। तस्यां तु वर्तमानायामिष्ट्यां भरतसत्तम॥४॥
verses.english: And oh, king, vaivasvata manu's fifth son नारिष्यत begot a son named शक, while vaivasvata manu's second son नाभाग begot a son named अम्बरीष, who in later time became an all-powerful emperor...

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणयोरंशे मुनिराहुतिमाजुहोत्। आहुत्यां हूयमानायां देवगन्धर्वमानुषाः॥५॥
verses.english: There arose a curvaceous girl, named lady इल, from that infallible Vedic-ritual, clad in divine raiment and decked with celestial ornaments... thus we hear...

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टिं तु परमां जग्मुर्मुनयश्च तपोधनाः। अहोऽस्य तपसो वीर्यमहोऽस्य श्रुतमद्भुतम्॥६॥
verses.english: And the sceptre-wielding vaivasvata manu, calling that girl as lady इल, has asked her, 'oh, providential girl, be pleased to follow me...' But, that girl ila conscientiously replied him who is longing for sons at that time...

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्याम्बरधरा दिव्याभरणभूषिता। दिव्यसंहनना चैव इला जज्ञे इति श्रुतिः॥७॥
verses.english: There arose a curvaceous girl, named lady इल, from that infallible Vedic-ritual, clad in divine raiment and decked with celestial ornaments... thus we hear...

verses.sanskrit: तामिलेत्येव होवाच मनुर्दण्डधरस्तदा। अनुगच्छस्व मां भद्रे तमिला प्रत्युवाच ह। धर्मयुक्तमिदं वाक्यं पुत्रकामं प्रजापतिम्॥८॥
verses.english: And the sceptre-wielding vaivasvata manu, calling that girl as lady इल, has asked her, 'oh, providential girl, be pleased to follow me...' But, that girl ila conscientiously replied him who is longing for sons at that time...

verses.sanskrit:
इलोवाच।
              मित्रावरुणयोरंशे जातास्मि वदतां वर। तयोः सकाशं यास्यामि न मां धर्मो हतोऽवधीत्॥९॥
verses.english: Wherever earth is adorned with Vedic-sacrificial posts, that entire central province has come under the rule of ikshvAku, the first son vaivasvata manu, along with its forests and mines...
verses.bhavadeepa: दण्डधरो राजा, भद्रे माम् अनुगच्छस्वेति तामिलामुवाचेति पूर्वेण सम्बन्धः। तं मनुम् इला प्रत्युवाचेत्युत्तरेण सम्बध्यते॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: सैवमुक्त्वा मनुं देवं मित्रावरुणयोरिला। गत्वान्तिकं वरारोहा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥१०॥
verses.english: utkala begot three sons who are renowned in all the three worlds, and those three are: धृSटक, अम्बरीSअ, and दण्ड...

verses.sanskrit: अंशेऽस्मि युवयोर्जाता देवौ किं करवाणि वाम्। मनुना चाहमुक्ता वै अनुगच्छस्व मामिति॥११॥
verses.english: "By this polite way of your seeking the permission, your self-righteousness, self-control, and truthfulness are established... oh, blessed girl, you will get renown as our child... you as the male descendant of manu will become the primogenitor of manu's lineage... and, oh, promising girl, you in your male form will be renowned as सुद्युम्न in all the three worlds, achieving the regard of the world, righteousness, and the progenitorship of manu's lineage..." So said mitra and varuNa to lady ila.

verses.sanskrit: तां तथावादिनीं साध्वीमिलां धर्मपरायणाम्। मित्रश्च वरुणश्चोभावूचतुर्यन्निबोध तत्॥१२॥
verses.english: Withdrawing from their presence on hearing the advice of mitra-varuNa that girl ila started towards her father's presence, i.e., to vaivasvata manu... but on her way back, बुध, the Jupiter, had a rendezvous with her as her swain...

verses.sanskrit: अनेन तव धर्मेण प्रश्रयेण दमेन च। सत्येन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतौ स्वो वरवर्णिनि॥१३॥
verses.english: Then पुरूरव took birth from her through budha, the son of soma... oh, king, and on delivering पुरूरव thus, she transfigured herself into the male form of सुद्युम्न...

verses.sanskrit: आवयोस्त्वं महाभागे ख्यातिं कन्येति यास्यसि। मनोर्वंशधरः पुत्रस्त्वमेव च भविष्यसि॥१४॥
verses.english: There are three highly righteous children to sudyumna, i.e., lady ila in male form, and they are: उत्कल, गय, and विनत-अश्व... and oh, king, vaivasvata manu gave east of उत्कल province to his son utkala, and west of उत्कल to vinata-ashva, while the city of गय is given to his third son gaya...

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्न इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु शोभने। जगत्प्रियो धर्मशीलो मनोर्वंशविवर्धनः॥१५॥
verses.english: When vaivasvata manu returned to Sun after his reign on earth, he made his kingdom in to ten divisions, and made his other sons to rule those divisions...
verses.bhavadeepa: मानवी घृतपदी मैत्रावरुणीति मन्त्रलिङ्गादिलाया उभयसम्बन्धो घटते। तत्राद्यमाह- आवयोरिति। द्वितीयमाह- मनोरिति॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्ता सा तु तच्छ्रुत्वा गच्छन्ती पितुरन्तिकम्। बुधेनान्तरमासाद्य मैथुनायोपमन्त्रिता॥१६॥
verses.english: Having ruled pratiShTAna-puram for some time, sudyumna relinquished it in favour of his / her son purUrava...

verses.sanskrit: सोमपुत्राद्बुधाद्राजंस्तस्यां जज्ञे पुरूरवाः। जनयित्वा सुतं सा तमिला सुद्युम्नतां गता॥१७॥
verses.english: Now that delightful city is named as द्वार-वति because it has numerous gateways... and it is now defended by the heroes of bhoja, vR^iShNi, andhaka clans, headed by their chief वसुदेव॥।

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्नस्य तु दायादास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः। उत्कलश्च गयश्चैव विनताश्वश्च भारत॥१८॥
verses.english: Having ruled pratiShTAna-puram for some time, sudyumna relinquished it in favour of his / her son purUrava...

verses.sanskrit: उत्कलस्योत्कला राजन्विनताश्वस्य पश्चिमा। दिक्पूर्वा भरतश्रेष्ठ गयस्य तु गया पुरी॥१९॥
verses.english: utkala begot three sons who are renowned in all the three worlds, and those three are: धृSटक, अम्बरीSअ, and दण्ड...

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टे तु मनौ तात दिवाकरमरिन्दम। दशधा तद्दधत्क्षत्रमकरोत्पृथिवीमिमाम्॥२०॥
verses.english: दण्ड developed world-renowned daNDaka forest as a best forest and a heavenly abode of sages and saints, where one gets rid of his sin just by entering it...

verses.sanskrit: यूपाङ्किता वसुमती यस्येयं सवनाकरा। इक्ष्वाकुर्ज्येष्ठदायादो मध्यदेशमवाप्तवान्॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus, she / he who as lady ila gave birth to purUrava in her maidenhood, and as sudyumna sired three sons in his manhood, became renowned in this world, because both femaleness and maleness altered in a single person, and later went to heaven...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रविष्ट इति। मनौ सूर्यं प्रविष्टे पुत्रान् उत्पाद्य त्यक्ताधिकारे प्रति इक्ष्वाकुप्रभृतयो दश मनोः पुत्राः पृथिवीं दशधा विभज्य गृहीतवन्तः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: कन्याभावाच्च सुद्युम्नो नैनं गुणमवाप्तवान्। वसिष्ठवचनाच्चासीत्प्रतिष्ठाने महात्मनः॥२२॥
verses.english: And oh, king, vaivasvata manu's fifth son नारिष्यत begot a son named शक, while vaivasvata manu's second son नाभाग begot a son named अम्बरीष, who in later time became an all-powerful emperor...

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठा धर्मराजस्य सुद्युम्नस्य कुरूद्वह। तत्पुरूरवसे प्रादाद्राज्यं प्राप्य महायशाः॥२३॥
verses.english: vaivasvata manu's third son धृSणु begot धार्ष्टक, who is an unassailable warrior, and vaivasvata manu's eighth son करूष begot कारूषा, who resulted as an unsurpassable kshatriya... from them hosts of valiant kshatriya-s have come down...
verses.bhavadeepa: सुद्युम्न एनं गुणं मध्यदेशराजत्वं वसिष्ठानुग्रहात्तु सुद्युम्नोऽपि तत्समीपदेशे राज्यं लेभे इत्याह- वसिष्ठेति। प्रतिष्ठाने प्रयागैकदेशे॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्नः कारयामास प्रतिष्ठाने नृपक्रियाम्। उत्कलस्य त्रयः पुत्रास्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताः। धृष्टकश्चाम्बरीषश्च दण्डश्चेति सुतास्त्रयः॥२४॥
verses.english: The progeny of vaivasvata manu's seventh son नाभाग-अरिष्ट have abandoned kshatriyahood and took up vaishya's vocation... i.e., trade and commerce...

verses.sanskrit: यश्चकार महात्मा वै दण्डकारण्यमुत्तमम्। वनं तल्लोकविख्यातं तापसानामनुत्तमम्॥२५॥
verses.english: vaivasvata manu's sixth son prAMshu begot only one son who is renowned by his named शर्याति, व्हिले vaivasvata manu's fifth son नरिष्यत begot a son who became the sceptre-wielding king named दम...

verses.sanskrit: तत्र प्रविष्टमात्रस्तु नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते। सुद्युम्नश्च दिवं यात ऐलमुत्पाद्य भारत॥२६॥
verses.english: vaivasvata manu's fourth son शर्याति begot a couple of children, of whom आनर्त is the boy, while the other is a girl named सुकन्य, who later became the wife of च्यवन-महर्षि॥। that boy आनर्त later became the father of a highly resplendent person named रेव॥। their province is आनर्त-देश, and their capital is कुश-स्थलि॥।

verses.sanskrit: मानवेयो महाराज स्त्रीपुंसोर्लक्षणैर्युतः। धृतवान्य इलेत्येव सुद्युम्नश्चातिविश्रुतः॥२७॥
verses.english: आनर्त's son रेव begot a son named रैवत, who is also called as most righteous ककुद्मि॥। because he is the eldest among hundred sons of रेव, this ककुद्मि, alias रैवत, got the kingdom and ruled from the capital कुश-स्थलि...

verses.sanskrit: नारिष्यतः शकाः पुत्रा नाभागस्य तु भारत। अम्बरीषोऽभवत्पुत्रः पार्थिवर्षभसत्तमः॥२८॥
verses.english: On certain occassion रैवत, or रेवत, went to the abode of brahma along with his daughter रेवति.... there he stayed just for a couple of hours more in the presence of brahma, fascinated to listen the music rendered by gandharvaa-s... in this meanwhile human era has lapsed in human world, and raivata returned to his capital, now hemmed in yAdava- s... but the physique of raivata has not changed retaining his youthfulness, with which he entered the abode of brahma a couple of hours back...

verses.sanskrit: धृष्णोस्तु धार्ष्टकं क्षत्रं रणधृष्टं बभूव ह। करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः॥२९॥
verses.english: Now that delightful city is named as द्वार-वति because it has numerous gateways... and it is now defended by the heroes of bhoja, vR^iShNi, andhaka clans, headed by their chief वसुदेव॥।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं क्षत्रियगणो विक्रान्तः सम्बभूव ह। नाभागारिष्टपुत्राश्च क्षत्रिया वैश्यतां गताः॥३०॥
verses.english: Then on knowing what actually has happened, raivata gave his impeccable daughter lady रेवति to बल-राम, the elder brother of Krishna, and himself repaired to the lofty heights of Mt. meru for furthering ascesis...

verses.sanskrit: प्रांशोरेकोऽभवत्पुत्रः शर्यातिरिति विश्रुतः। नरिष्यतस्य दायादो राजा दण्डधरो दमः। शर्यातेर्मिथुनं चासीदानर्तो नाम विश्रुतः॥३१॥
verses.english: On certain occassion रैवत, or रेवत, went to the abode of brahma along with his daughter रेवति.... there he stayed just for a couple of hours more in the presence of brahma, fascinated to listen the music rendered by gandharvaa-s... in this meanwhile human era has lapsed in human world, and raivata returned to his capital, now hemmed in yAdava- s... but the physique of raivata has not changed retaining his youthfulness, with which he entered the abode of brahma a couple of hours back...

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रः कन्याः सुकन्याख्या या पत्नी च्यवनस्य ह। आनर्तस्य तु दायादो रेवो नाम महाद्युतिः॥३२॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the tenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of लद्य् इल.

verses.sanskrit: आनर्तविषयश्चासीत्पुरी चास्य कुशस्थली। रेवस्य रैवतः पुत्रः ककुद्मी नाम धार्मिकः॥३३॥
verses.english: आनर्त's son रेव begot a son named रैवत, who is also called as most righteous ककुद्मि॥। because he is the eldest among hundred sons of रेव, this ककुद्मि, alias रैवत, got the kingdom and ruled from the capital कुश-स्थलि...

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठः पुत्रशतस्यासीद्राज्यं प्राप्य कुशस्थलीम्। स कन्यासहितः श्रुत्वा गान्धर्वं ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिके॥३४॥
मुहूर्तभूतं देवस्य गतं बहुयुगं प्रभो। आजगाम युवैवाथ स्वां पुरीं यादवैर्वृताम्॥३५॥
कृतां द्वारवतीं नाम्ना बहुद्वारां मनोरमाम्। भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकैर्गुप्तां वासुदेवपुरोगमैः॥३६॥
ततः स रैवतो ज्ञात्वा यथातत्त्वमरिन्दम। कन्यां तां बलदेवाय सुव्रतां नाम रेवतीम्॥३७॥
दत्त्वा जगाम शिखरं मेरोस्तपसि संस्थितः। रेमे रामोऽपि धर्मात्मा रेवत्या सहितः सुखी॥३८॥
